meta_title: Lime Tree Decorators | Painter & Decorator Birmingham
meta_description: Lime Tree Decorators Birmingham offers interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and full decoration services. Free quotes, professional finish guaranteed.
hero_eyebrow: Professional Decorators — Free Quotes, No Hidden Costs
hero_subhead: From tired walls to rooms you'll love. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and full decoration — finished on time, on budget.
services_subhead: We handle everything from a single room refresh to full house renovation, inside and out.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, and woodwork painted to a flawless finish. We prep thoroughly, use quality paints, and protect your furniture and floors.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Weatherproof your home with durable exterior paint, fence treatment, and cladding refresh. Built to last the Birmingham climate.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Bespoke wallpaper fitting, including tricky alcoves and feature walls. We source samples, advise on patterns, and hang perfectly.

services.title: Plastering & Wall Preparation
services.desc: Cracked plaster, damp patches, and uneven walls fixed before decoration. A smooth surface is the foundation of a professional finish.

services.title: Tile Painting & Kitchen Refresh
services.desc: Breathe new life into tired kitchen and bathroom tiles without full replacement. Hard-wearing paint that resists moisture and daily wear.

services.title: Commercial Decoration
services.desc: Shops, offices, and rental properties redecorated on time and within budget. We minimise disruption and work around your schedule.

about_pullquote: We treat every room like it's our own home — attention to detail, no shortcuts, honest pricing.
about_para_1: Lime Tree Decorators was founded in 2010 by a painter frustrated with sloppy workmanship and inflated quotes. We built the business on a simple promise: turn up on time, do the job right, and charge fairly. Today we've decorated hundreds of homes and businesses across Birmingham, from Victorian terraces to modern apartments.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, we plan carefully, and we finish on schedule. We don't rush, and we don't cut corners — whether it's a single bedroom or a full commercial refit. Many of our best jobs come from word-of-mouth referrals, which tells you everything about how we work.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the lounge and hallway decorated. Lads turned up bang on time, protected everything, and didn't leave a mess. Finished a day early. Really pleased with the work — would definitely use them again.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Nightmare with damp on the kitchen walls. They sorted the prep work properly, didn't try to cover it up, and the finish is brilliant. Fair price and friendly service. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire T.

reviews.text: Our shop needed redecorating between letting it out. Quick turnaround, no fuss, and they worked around our hours. Professional outfit. Will use them for the next unit.
reviews.author: Priya K.
